questions.prompt: How does a clustered system differ from a multiprocessor system?
options: A cluster has only one CPU
A cluster joins multiple whole computers; a multiprocessor puts several CPUs in one computer

options: Nothing but monitor the active server, ready to take over if it fails

questions.prompt: What does a distributed lock manager (DLM) prevent?
options: Conflicting operations when several nodes access shared data
